name: Tuantu's lobotomization branches
desc:
Version 0.9.1

EPILEPSY WARNING: This game contains bright, flashing lights and imagery that may not be suitable for those with photosensitive epilepsy.

A copy of Lobotomy Corporation (You should buy it NOW!) and lightly inspired by Item Asylum

Welcome to Tuantu's Lobotomization Branches where you can fight abnormalities, grind, ruin people's day by releasing the abnormalities, or just more grinding.

Credits are moved in the game menu.

Keybinds:
T - Stats
Q - Dash
F - Block/Parry
M - Gifts
P - Settings
Z - Minimap
G - Stims
V - Carry
J - Encyclopedia
L - Open Public EGO Pool
Middle Click - Ping object (Requires map)

Facility owner commands:
/kick [Player name]
/ban [Player name]
/unban [Player name]
/sessionshutdown
/resetday
/memrep
/dictatortoggle [true/false]
